foreseal.note: Not yet supplied by ForeSeal as of manifest creation. To be filled in and re-hashed before any funds move.

reference_source.why_this_reference: Deterministic, keyless, re-runnable by anyone, controlled by neither party. Independently confirmed live against api.github.com on 2026-09-06.

claim.expected_truth_condition: GET https://api.github.com/repos/python/cpython/pulls/154769 returns merged:true and merge_commit_sha == c7b9a13a7528342fdac47a2121248f0b989131e5.
claim.freshness: permanent (once merged, this fact does not change)

lifecycle_steps.action: ForeSeal calls POST /claim-verdict from a ForeSeal-controlled wallet, paying the x402-quoted price, with resolver spec above.
lifecycle_steps.must_not_use: The free tier (no payment) does not return a verdict_receipt hash/signature to the caller and is NOT usable for this test -- confirmed live 2026-09-06 (signed:false, verdict_receipt:null on the free path).

lifecycle_steps.action: StillOS returns a signed, hash-chained claim receipt AND a signed, hash-chained verdict receipt, both bound to the resolver above.
StillOS resolves the claim against api.github.com in real time and posts the verdict inline in the same response.

ForeSeal verifies the verdict receipt OFFLINE: recompute receipt_hash, resolve notary_fp against the PINNED key/keyring below (not a live /notary/health call), verify Ed25519 signature, confirm chain to prior receipt.
ForeSeal files POST /dispute with receipt_hash + the exact verdict_object it received + the same resolver spec + counter-evidence/reason.
verdict_dispute.cjs re-runs the SAME resolver spec fresh, right now, and compares the fresh label to the original verdict label.
lifecycle_steps.expected_result: REJECTED (fresh re-run reconfirms CONFIRMED, since the claim is objectively, permanently true) -- this is a valid, successful exercise of the full adjudication path, not a failed test. See dispute_semantics below.

lifecycle_steps.action: IF (and only if) the dispute is UPHELD, a slash directive is queued (DRY-RUN, founder alert fired) -- NOT auto-paid. Marcus reviews and, if he approves, runs notary_bond_slash.cjs --execute manually.

dispute_semantics.scripted_exercise_disclosure: Because the reference claim (an already-merged, permanent GitHub PR fact) is objectively true and cannot change, a good-faith dispute against it is EXPECTED to resolve REJECTED on re-run. This test is a SCRIPTED EXERCISE of the intake -> re-run -> terminal-state adjudication path, not an attempt to manufacture a false original verdict. A REJECTED terminal state is a successful, valid test outcome under this manifest, identical in evidentiary value to an UPHELD one -- both prove the mechanism runs against a real external counterparty. Neither party will characterize a REJECTED outcome as a failed test.
dispute_semantics.hash_binding: The disputer must supply the exact verdict_object they were given; it is checked against the receipt's committed claim_sha256 before anything else runs -- a fabricated verdict_object is rejected before any write.
dispute_semantics.target_mutation_guard: The fresh re-run's settles_against must equal the original verdict's settles_against, or the dispute is rejected -- a disputer cannot swap in an easier target.
dispute_semantics.dispute_window: 48 hours from the original verdict receipt's timestamp.

signing_identity.keyring_disclosure: The active key has already rotated once (2026-06-27 key retired 2026-07-31, superseded by the key pinned above). GET /notary/keyring (added 2026-09-06) returns the full historical registry keyed by fingerprint so a receipt signed under ANY past or future key remains independently verifiable without ever trusting /notary/health's current contents at verification time.

stillos_payto_wallet.purpose: Receives x402 settlement + dispute fees (operational revenue wallet, NOT the bond wallet).

stillos_bond_wallet.purpose: Collateral only. Source of any slash payout. Independently verifiable via USDC.balanceOf on Base.

settlement_fee_usd.note: Time-bound launch pricing, disclosed here so the number cannot surprise either party mid-negotiation.

dispute_fee_usd.note: No free tier for /dispute. Non-refundable either way (anti-spam design), disclosed up front.

fees.gas_responsibility: x402 uses EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization -- ForeSeal signs an off-chain authorization and pays ZERO gas. StillOS's facilitator submits the on-chain transfer and pays Base gas on both settlement and dispute-fee collection.
fees.other_fees_in_this_lifecycle: None. (POST /self-audit/dispute-entry at $2.00 is a separate, unrelated product surface and is explicitly out of scope for this test.)

stillos_total_outlay_usd.condition: only if the dispute is UPHELD, requires a separate Marcus-approved --execute to actually pay; never automatic
stillos_total_outlay_usd.gas_for_payout: borne by the bond wallet's existing Base ETH balance, already funded above the required floor

bond.funding_status: NOT YET FUNDED as of manifest creation -- see funding proposal in the accompanying report. Manifest will be re-hashed and re-published once funded, before any settlement is requested from ForeSeal.
bond.verify_instruction: Anyone can independently call USDC.balanceOf(wallet) on Base mainnet. Do not trust this file or /notary/bond's numbers without checking the chain directly.

expected_terminal_states: settlement: settled:true on Base, payer wallet != any StillOS-controlled address
verdict: CONFIRMED (matches independent re-run of the same GitHub PR)
offline_verification: signature_valid AND hash_intact AND chain_intact, computed with zero network calls to StillOS
dispute: REJECTED (expected, since the claim is objectively true) OR UPHELD (would trigger a queued, non-automatic slash directive)
if UPHELD: slash_directive status QUEUED_PENDING_APPROVAL -- payout requires a separate explicit Marcus --execute, is not part of this test's automatic scope

publication_terms.n_equals_1_disclosure: This is a single controlled test. Neither party may cite it as statistical validation, general production reliability, or that the other party endorses the implementation.

abort_conditions: resolver source/spec not mutually frozen in writing before step 1
any exposure exceeding the $2.00 combined hard stop
payer wallet turns out to be StillOS-controlled (would invalidate the test as a self-payment)
settlement amount does not match the fee disclosed in this manifest
resolver target does not match the frozen reference above
any automated money movement beyond what this manifest explicitly authorizes
